Your **AI Writing System** is in place, mapped to [Tiago Forte's walkthrough](https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=TUfGJY7gRxw) and [results video](https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=vlc_enCxaJE). You already had the style guide (`jorap-voice`, `garden-voice`, lint rules). What was missing was the **process layer** — interview, framework pick, draft, feedback loop.

## What was built

New skill: `.cursor/skills/ai-writing-system/`

| File | Forte equivalent | Purpose |
|------|------------------|---------|
| `SKILL.md` | Claude Project | Entry point, routing, session checklist |
| `implementation-guide.md` | Implementation Guide | Interview → frameworks → draft → human pass → lint |
| `writing-samples.md` | Writing samples | 13 calibration posts/notes by lane |
| `style-priorities.md` | Prioritization fix | Ranked rules when they conflict |
| `feedback-loop.md` | "Copy to project" | Patch the system when the same mistake repeats |

Also: `scripts/ai-writing-samples-check.mjs` + `pnpm test:writing-samples` to verify sample paths.

`jorap-voice` and `garden-voice` now point here for **new** content from scratch.

## How to use it

**Start a blog post:**
```
Run the AI writing system for a new blog post about [topic].
Interview me one question at a time. Don't draft until I pick a framework.
```

**Expand an outline:**
```
Expand this outline using the AI writing system. Mark [NEEDS SCENE] where you need my memory.

[paste outline]
```

**After a heavy edit session:**
```
Debrief this writing session for the feedback loop.
```

## The four steps (your repo)

1. **Samples** → `writing-samples.md` (read 1–2 in the same lane)
2. **Style guide** → `jorap-voice` / `garden-voice` (already built)
3. **Implementation** → interview, propose 2–3 structures, draft at ~90%, your 1–2 human passes
4. **Feedback loop** → same failure twice → patch `voice-words.yaml`, skills, or interview questions — not just the draft

## Forte vs your setup

| Forte (Claude Projects) | JoRap (Cursor) |
|-------------------------|----------------|
| Upload style guide | `jorap-voice` / `garden-voice` skills |
| Implementation guide prompts | `implementation-guide.md` |
| One question at a time | Agent must wait between interview questions |
| Copy mistake back to project | `feedback-loop.md` → commit a one-line rule |
| 90–95% first draft | Seven voice passes + `pnpm slop:score` |

The system blocks **invented anecdotes** with `[NEEDS SCENE]` — Forte's main failure mode in the demo (AI opened with a personal story that wasn't his).

Want to run a live session on a topic you have in mind?

## Session close
- Fixed: Built Tiago Forte-style AI writing system skill with implementation guide, samples, priorities, feedback loop, and sample path check.
- Encode: none
- Open: clean

| **Density** | Right length for the job — not padded, not gutted |
| **Swap test** | Couldn't paste into a generic tech blog unchanged |

## Rules that make this work

1. **One thesis per post** — framework, metaphor, stories, filter, or case study. Not a second full guide.
2. **Cross-link up** — each new draft points to the canonical post for depth ("read the full fit check there").
3. **No slug theft** — removed `aliases: ["published-slug"]` so Hugo won't redirect the live URL.
4. **Trim overlap** — checklist sections, five-question encyclopedias, and duplicate "buried by lunch" beats stay on the original.

## Publish order (if you ship them)

1. **Stack mismatch stories** or **AI contractor** — most standalone, least overlap.
2. **Three places** — pairs with sustainable publishing; publish both or link heavily.
3. **Tenant not landlord** — overlaps `why-run-your-own-website`; publish after you trim the original or accept some repetition.
4. **Free vs freedom** — shortest; good newsletter-length piece.

## What not to do

- Don't publish all five in one week — Google and readers will see duplicate intent.
- Don't leave both original and retheme covering the same H2s without cross-links.
- Don't use alts as A/B replacements — use them as **entry points** for different readers (framework vs story vs metaphor).

Want a hybrid pass on one pair next (e.g. graft "three buckets" into `sustainable-online-publishing` and keep the standalone frame post shorter)?
